_comment: Example configuration for the Telegram bridge. Copy this file to config.json (or export the same values as environment variables) and fill in your own values. NEVER commit a filled-in config.json — it is gitignored. See README.md for setup.
_comment_bot_id: Your bot's numeric Telegram ID (from @BotFather, or from a getMe call). Used to skip the bot's own group messages. Env var: TELEGRAM_BOT_ID.
_comment_bot_token: Your bot token from @BotFather. NEVER put a real token in a committed file. Env var: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (preferred). This field is only a reminder of where the token goes.
_comment_bot_username: Your bot's @username without the @ (optional). Used as a group mention token. Env var: TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME.
_comment_mention_tokens: Extra words that count as addressing the bot in a group (optional). Set as a comma-separated list in env var TELEGRAM_MENTION_TOKENS. Broadcast tokens (all members / @everyone etc.) are built in and do not need to be listed here.
_comment_owner_chat_id: Your private chat ID with the bot (usually the same as owner_user_id). Env var: TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID.
_comment_owner_user_id: Your Telegram user ID (the owner). Only this user can chat privately with the bot. Env var: TELEGRAM_OWNER_USER_ID.
